description_en: Calls a published Mobile-Use Agent instance, which supports the Standard Edition and Dedicated Edition. Submits the task text and the current screen screenshot, passes the device and application context through metadata, and returns the next mobile UI operation by using Server-Sent Events (SSE). The caller executes the UI operation and then continues to call the API with the session ID and the latest screenshot
description_zh: 调用已发布的 Mobile-Use Agent，支持标准版和专属版。提交任务文本和当前屏幕截图，通过 metadata 传入设备与应用上下文，以 SSE 返回下一步手机界面操作。界面操作由调用方执行，执行后携带会话 ID 和最新截图继续调用
name: GuiChatCompletionStream

parameters.help_en: The access key of the agent instance, which is used to authenticate QICloud Customer API operations
parameters.help_zh: Agent 实例访问密钥，用于 QICloud Customer 接口鉴权
parameters.name: x_qi_agent_api_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the published Mobile-Use Agent instance. This ID must correspond to the X-QI-Agent-Api-Key
parameters.help_zh: 已发布的 Mobile-Use Agent 实例 ID，必须与 X-QI-Agent-Api-Key 对应
parameters.name: x_qi_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The optional session identifier. You can omit this parameter in the first step, and it is generated by the server. You must pass back the same value in subsequent Mobile-Use Agent steps to continue the state
parameters.help_zh: 可选会话标识。首步可省略，由服务端生成；后续 Mobile-Use Agent 步骤必须传回同一值续接状态
parameters.name: x_qi_session_id

parameters.help_en: The whitelist of token IDs that are allowed to be generated
parameters.help_zh: 允许生成的 Token ID 白名单
parameters.name: allowed_token_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of words or strings that are banned from being generated
parameters.help_zh: 禁止生成的词或字符串列表
parameters.name: bad_words

fields.help_en: chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking: the request-level switch for model thinking, which overrides the default value with the same name. Enabling this switch does not cause the Mobile-Use Agent response to return reasoning_content
fields.help_zh: chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking：请求级模型思考开关，覆盖同名默认值。Mobile-Use Agent 响应不会因开启该开关而返回 reasoning_content
fields.name: enable_thinking

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to preserve the existing thinking context in subsequent rounds. This parameter is passed as-is according to the vLLM or Qwen chat_template_kwargs
fields.help_zh: 是否在续轮中保留已有思考上下文；按 vLLM/Qwen chat_template_kwargs 原样透传
fields.name: preserve_thinking

parameters.help_en: The vLLM or OpenAI-compatible template parameter object. The request values override the default values with the same names in the model and are passed as-is to the primary model of the Mobile-Use Agent
parameters.help_zh: vLLM/OpenAI-Compatible 模板参数对象。请求值会覆盖模型默认同名值并原样传给 Mobile-Use Agent 主模型
parameters.name: chat_template_kwargs

parameters.help_en: The frequency penalty parameter, which is passed through to the primary model of the Mobile-Use Agent
parameters.help_zh: 频率惩罚参数，透传给 Mobile-Use Agent 主模型
parameters.name: frequency_penalty

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to ignore the end-of-sequence (EOS) token and continue generation
parameters.help_zh: 是否忽略 EOS 并继续生成
parameters.name: ignore_eos

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to request the upstream to generate the reasoning field. The client-facing results of the Mobile-Use Agent do not directly expose internal thinking
parameters.help_zh: 是否请求上游生成推理字段；Mobile-Use Agent 对客结果不会直接暴露内部思考
parameters.name: include_reasoning

parameters.help_en: The model compatibility parameter. The JSON field is logprobs. Whether this parameter is accepted and takes effect depends on the model used by the instance. The current Mobile-Use Agent response does not provide token log probability details
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容参数，JSON 字段为 logprobs。是否接受及生效取决于实例所用模型；当前 Mobile-Use Agent 响应不提供 Token 对数概率明细
parameters.name: logprobs

parameters.help_en: The OpenAI-compatible maximum number of completion tokens. If provided, the value must be greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: OpenAI 兼容最大补全 Token 数，提供时必须大于 0
parameters.name: max_completion_tokens

parameters.help_en: The OpenAI-compatible maximum number of generated tokens. If provided, the value must be greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: OpenAI 兼容最大生成 Token 数，提供时必须大于 0
parameters.name: max_tokens

fields.help_en: The compatible inline image field for input_image. You can pass a Base64 data URL
fields.help_zh: input_image 的兼容内联图片字段；可传 Base64 Data URL
fields.name: image_data

fields.help_en: A publicly accessible HTTPS image URL or a Base64 image data URL. Each round of user messages must and can only contain one current screenshot. Expired or inaccessible image addresses are rejected
fields.help_zh: 公开可访问的 HTTPS 图片 URL，或 Base64 图片 Data URL。每轮 user 消息必须且只能包含一张当前截图；已过期或无法访问的图片地址会被拒绝
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The screenshot reference. Supports an image_url string or an object containing a url field. The object format is shown here
fields.help_zh: 截图引用。支持 image_url 字符串或包含 url 的对象；此处展示对象形式
fields.name: image_url

fields.help_en: The text content, which can describe the current operation objective or supplement the current page state
fields.help_zh: 文本内容，可描述当前操作目标或补充当前页面状态
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The type of the content item. Use text or input_text for text. Use image_url or input_image for screenshots
fields.help_zh: 内容项类型。文本使用 text 或 input_text；截图使用 image_url 或 input_image
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The message content. For a user message, use a content array that contains exactly one current screenshot and optionally attached task text. Screenshots support public HTTPS URLs or Base64 image data URLs. When role is set to tool, fill in the actual execution result of the previous action, which can be a non-empty string, object, or array
fields.help_zh: 消息内容。user 使用内容数组，包含恰好一张当前截图，并可附加任务文字；截图支持公开 HTTPS URL 或 Base64 图片 Data URL。role=tool 时填上一动作的真实执行结果，可为非空字符串、对象或数组
fields.name: content

fields.help_en: The message role. The current input must end with a user message. If an execution receipt from the previous round exists, the preceding message must be a tool message
fields.help_zh: 消息角色。当前输入必须以 user 结尾；存在上一轮执行回执时前一条必须为 tool
fields.name: role

fields.help_en: Required when role is set to tool. References the tool_call ID from the previous Mobile-Use Agent response
fields.help_zh: role=tool 时必填，引用上一轮 Mobile-Use Agent 响应的 tool_call id
fields.name: tool_call_id

parameters.help_en: The messages for the current Mobile-Use Agent step. The first step can only contain one user message. Subsequent steps can only contain one tool message followed by one user message. Complete multi-round history is not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 当前 Mobile-Use Agent 步骤消息。首步只能包含一条 user；后续步骤只能是一条 tool 后跟一条 user，不允许携带完整多轮历史
parameters.name: messages

fields.help_en: The compatible alias for available_apps, which is also an array of app name strings
fields.help_zh: available_apps 的兼容别名；同样是 App 名称字符串数组
fields.name: app_list

fields.help_en: The supplementary list of application names for the Standard Edition of Mobile-Use Agent. The JSON field is available_apps. The newly passed list replaces the previous supplementary items, but the default applications are retained. An empty array does not clear the default applications. The Dedicated Edition of Mobile-Use Agent does not use this list
fields.help_zh: Mobile-Use Agent 标准版 的应用名称补充列表，JSON 字段为 available_apps。新传入列表替换之前的补充项，但默认应用仍保留；空数组不清空默认应用。Mobile-Use Agent 专属版 不使用此列表
fields.name: available_apps

fields.help_en: The Mobile-Use Agent Harness receipt text for legacy clients. This cannot be passed at the same time as the preceding tool message. New clients should prioritize using [tool,user] messages
fields.help_zh: 旧客户端的 Mobile-Use Agent Harness 回执文本；与前置 tool 消息不能同时传。新客户端优先使用 [tool,user] 消息
fields.name: harness_message

fields.help_en: The screen height as a positive integer. For Base64 images, the width and height are parsed from the image itself. For URL images, this value is used for the runtime screen size
fields.help_zh: 屏幕高度正整数。base64 图片会从图片本身解析宽高；URL 图片时该值用于运行时屏幕尺寸
fields.name: screen_height

fields.help_en: The screen width as a positive integer. For Base64 images, the width and height are parsed from the image itself. For URL images, this value is used for the runtime screen size
fields.help_zh: 屏幕宽度正整数。base64 图片会从图片本身解析宽高；URL 图片时该值用于运行时屏幕尺寸
fields.name: screen_width

parameters.help_en: The metadata for the Mobile-Use Agent step. Supports screen_width, screen_height, available_apps, and the compatibility field harness_message. The tool receipt and harness_message cannot be passed at the same time
parameters.help_zh: Mobile-Use Agent 步骤元数据。支持 screen_width、screen_height、available_apps 和兼容字段 harness_message；tool 回执与 harness_message 不可同时传
parameters.name: metadata

parameters.help_en: The vLLM Min-P sampling parameter
parameters.help_zh: vLLM Min-P 采样参数
parameters.name: min_p

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of tokens to generate
parameters.help_zh: 最少生成 Token 数
parameters.name: min_tokens

fields.help_en: The maximum number of dynamic image patches allowed by the vision model
fields.help_zh: 示例：视觉模型允许的最大动态图像 patch 数
fields.name: max_dynamic_patch

parameters.help_en: The multimodal preprocessor parameters, passed through to the Mobile-Use Agent primary model as-is by key
parameters.help_zh: 多模态预处理器参数，按键原样透传给 Mobile-Use Agent 主模型
parameters.name: mm_processor_kwargs

parameters.help_en: Reserved for OpenAI client compatibility. This parameter is ignored during routing. The model is determined by the published configuration of the instance, and the model field in the response is always an empty string
parameters.help_zh: 为 OpenAI 客户端兼容保留；路由时忽略，模型由实例已发布配置决定，响应 model 固定为空字符串
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: Set this parameter to 1. Whether this parameter is accepted depends on the model. The current Mobile-Use Agent response does not return multiple candidate actions
parameters.help_zh: 建议设为 1。该参数是否被模型接受取决于模型；当前 Mobile-Use Agent 响应不会透出多个候选动作
parameters.name: n

parameters.help_en: The model-compatible switch to invoke parallel tool calling. This parameter does not expand the set of Mobile-Use Agent actions active for this operation
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容的并行工具调用开关，不会扩大本接口可用的 Mobile-Use Agent 动作集合
parameters.name: parallel_tool_calls

parameters.help_en: The presence penalty parameter, passed through to the Mobile-Use Agent primary model
parameters.help_zh: 存在惩罚参数，透传给 Mobile-Use Agent 主模型
parameters.name: presence_penalty

parameters.help_en: A model-compatible parameter. The JSON field is prompt_logprobs. Whether this parameter is accepted depends on the model. The current Mobile-Use Agent response does not return input token probability details
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容参数，JSON 字段为 prompt_logprobs。是否接受取决于模型；当前 Mobile-Use Agent 响应不返回输入 Token 概率明细
parameters.name: prompt_logprobs

parameters.help_en: The OpenAI-compatible reasoning effort, such as low, medium, or high
parameters.help_zh: OpenAI 兼容推理强度，例如 low、medium、high
parameters.name: reasoning_effort

parameters.help_en: The vLLM repetition penalty parameter
parameters.help_zh: vLLM 重复惩罚参数
parameters.name: repetition_penalty

fields.help_en: The response format type, such as text, json_object, or json_schema
fields.help_zh: 响应格式类型，例如 text、json_object 或 json_schema
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The model-compatible structured output options. This parameter does not change the final Mobile-Use Agent tool calling structure when you invoke this operation. Avoid output constraint Settings that conflict with the action protocol
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容的结构化输出选项，不改变本接口最终的 Mobile-Use Agent 工具调用结构。请避免设置与动作协议冲突的输出约束
parameters.name: response_format

parameters.help_en: The random seed
parameters.help_zh: 随机种子
parameters.name: seed

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to skip special tokens
parameters.help_zh: 是否跳过特殊 Token
parameters.name: skip_special_tokens

parameters.help_en: The stop sequences. This parameter is compatible with a single string or an array of strings. The array format is shown here
parameters.help_zh: 停止序列。兼容单个字符串或字符串数组；此处展示数组形式
parameters.name: stop

parameters.help_en: The list of vLLM stop token IDs
parameters.help_zh: vLLM 停止 Token ID 列表
parameters.name: stop_token_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use Server-Sent Events (SSE) for streaming responses. You must set this parameter to true for this operation
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用 SSE 流式响应。本接口必须传 true
parameters.name: stream

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to output the usage statistics block before data:[DONE]
fields.help_zh: 是否在 data:[DONE] 之前输出 usage 统计块
fields.name: include_usage

parameters.help_en: The OpenAI-compatible streaming options
parameters.help_zh: OpenAI 兼容流式选项
parameters.name: stream_options

fields.help_en: The set of allowed enum text values
fields.name: choice

parameters.help_en: The vLLM structured output constraints
parameters.help_zh: vLLM 结构化输出约束
parameters.name: structured_outputs

parameters.help_en: The sampling temperature, which overrides the default value of the Mobile-Use Agent primary model
parameters.help_zh: 采样温度，覆盖 Mobile-Use Agent 主模型默认值
parameters.name: temperature

parameters.help_en: The vLLM Top-K sampling parameter
parameters.help_zh: vLLM Top-K 采样参数
parameters.name: topk

parameters.help_en: A model-compatible parameter. The JSON field is top_logprobs. Whether this parameter is accepted depends on the model. The current Mobile-Use Agent response does not return candidate token probability details
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容参数，JSON 字段为 top_logprobs。是否接受取决于模型；当前 Mobile-Use Agent 响应不返回候选 Token 概率明细
parameters.name: top_logprobs

parameters.help_en: The Top-P nucleus sampling parameter, which overrides the default value of the Mobile-Use Agent primary model
parameters.help_zh: Top-P 核采样参数，覆盖 Mobile-Use Agent 主模型默认值
parameters.name: topp

schema.description_en: The SSE streaming response metadata. Business events are returned consecutively and end with data:[DONE]. For the complete format, refer to the supplementary description of response parameters
schema.description_zh: SSE 流式响应元数据。业务事件连续返回，最终以 data:[DONE] 结束；完整格式见返回参数补充说明

requestId.description_en: The request identity generated by the POP gateway for gateway Tracing Analysis. For the agent request ID, refer to qi_request_id in the SSE body
requestId.description_zh: 由 POP 网关生成的请求标识，用于网关链路追踪；Agent 请求 ID 以 SSE 正文中的 qi_request_id 为准

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body for calling the Mobile-Use Agent. Submit the current objective and screenshot in the first call. In subsequent rounds, submit the actual result of the previous action and a new screenshot without replaying historical messages. The Chat Completions fields use snake_case, and the stream parameter must be set to true
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: Mobile-Use Agent 调用请求体。首次调用提交当前目标和截图；续轮提交上一动作真实结果及新截图，不重放历史消息。Chat Completions 字段使用 snake_case，stream 设为 true
v1_body_parameters.name: body
